$comment: Release validation report (DD-25), config of this repo for validation-report.mjs (same script in deepdots-popup-sdk and deepdots-popup-mobile-native-sdk). Each category lists its tests by name ('flows') or by regex on the test id ('match'); validation-report.test.mjs fails if a Maestro flow is in no category. 'safety' = host-app safety checks of section 4.
intro: SDK {version} was validated as published (Maven Central and Swift Package Manager) inside dedicated native test applications that integrate the SDK the same way a customer app does.

controls.negative-control: Negative control: the bug customers saw on the control version is detected
controls.r8-control: R8 control: the control version fails a minified release build, the tested one builds

deviceLogCheck: Crash, freeze (ANR) or threading errors in the device log, and no request to production (every configuration)
environmentNote: All automated tests ran against the Deepdots development environment with test companies only. No customer data was used, and each configuration fails if any request reaches the production API.
limitations: Emulators and simulators cover the OS versions, not every manufacturer; real devices are checked by hand (section 7).
Visual regression (screenshot comparison) is not yet automated for the native SDK.
Tests marked as known issues are expected to fail until their fix ships; if one passes, the run fails so the mark is removed.

realDevices.intro: Filled in by hand after this report is generated: release build of the test app with this exact version on one Android phone, one iPhone and one iPad.
checks: Survey answered and sent to the end
Not shown again within its cooldown
Taps outside the popup do not reach the app; X closes it
Background / foreground with the popup open
No network: notice, can be closed, app usable

categories.name: Navigation and app lifecycle (background / foreground, rotation)
Detection check: a missing navigation event is caught

safety.label: No invisible layer blocks the app after the popup closes
Survey that cannot load: the popup can be closed and the app stays usable
Popup configuration that cannot load: no popup, the app stays usable
No network: no popup, the app stays usable
Network lost right after a popup is triggered
Slow network while the survey loads
Background / foreground with a popup open
The same popup triggered several times: shown once
SDK initialised more than once by the host
